items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: the guys in my band, Teddy Buckner and some others

ctx.x: Well how would you go out there?

You would go out in a car but it was a long...... long ride. It's like going to Queens XxXxXxXxXx only worse. It takes longer. So I just don't know what to do. I'm thinking. I didn't have any money I was broke. And I didn't know whether I wanted to get married. China or no China, I didn't know whether..... So I was, I was leaning up against a telephone pole and I could see everybody was going out to Hollywood. All of the actors, all the singers, Nat King Cole was one. And I was leaning up against the telephone…

I says, I don't know. They said, we're going on out anyway, you know. So I stood right by that telephone pole you see, trying to make up my mind. I stayed there, twelve o'clock. I still was there at one o'clock. That was when I should have been in Hollywood. And I was there until about one, almost one thirty when the guys in my band, Teddy Buckner and some others....
